metadata.title: CoDe Hand Study 0-4 PI report: data

definitions.c_pad: pad coverage C̄_pad: mean share of the finger length covered by the proximal and distal pads (fraction, 0-1), best design found by the search (GA and NSGA-II, 3 seeds each)
definitions.c_pad_worst_run: worst of the search runs for that cell
definitions.required_flexion_deg: q_req, the PIP flexion the design must reach without collision
definitions.d_contact_mm: Δ_contact: change of the distal contact point's path, seen from the proximal pad face (the PIP column of the contact Jacobian), between the 3 mm reference and the redesign; max over flexion (Study 2) or the hand's value (Study 3)
definitions.d_skel_mm: Δ_skel: change of the fingertip path seen from the link line (skeleton motion)
definitions.fixed_axis_bound_mm: lowest Δ_contact any fixed-axis joint can reach for that thickness change: 2 sin(q_req/2) Δh
definitions.F: pull-out limit load (N): the load at which the two-pad grasp of the cylinder gives way
definitions.D: effect of the friction change: F(mu 2.0) - F(mu 1.3), N
definitions.E: error a redesign adds to the measured effect: |D(hand) - D(O)| / |D(O)|; per hand, the median over the placements and directions scored on both hands
definitions.O, R, U: O: 3 mm reference finger; R: 7 mm redesign keeping the contact-surface motion (Δ_contact 0.86 mm); U: 7 mm redesign for coverage only (Δ_contact 3.91 mm)
definitions.clean_timeout_rate: share of episodes in which the cube was still held at 20 s
definitions.turn rates: share of episodes whose cube turned at least 1/4, 1/2, 3/4 of a turn about the vertical axis while within 40 mm and 60 deg tilt; the full turn also requires a clean timeout

metadata.scope: Simulation only. Studies 1-2: 2D side model, finger length 90 mm. Study 3: CFL, q_req 120 deg, joint impedance control with O's joint setpoint reused unless stated. Study 4: Isaac Lab 3, hand O, 1,024 held-out grasps.

study3_pairs_drake_point.description: Experiment 21, Drake point contact, condition A (O's joint setpoint reused). F = pull-out limit load (N) at friction mu 1.3 and 2.0; D = F(2.0) - F(1.3); E = |D(H) - D(O)| / |D(O)|.

isaac_A.label: Isaac Lab
isaac_A.description: Isaac Lab 3 (Newton MuJoCo-Warp), point contact; O's placements; friction mu 1.3 -> 2.0; pull-out

drake_point.label: Drake point
drake_point.description: Drake (SAP), point contact 2.5 kN/m; experiment 21; pull-out

drake_hydro.label: Drake hydro
drake_hydro.description: Drake, hydroelastic pads 0.1 MPa over 3 mm on every hand; experiment 21; pull-out

soft_pad.label: 두께만큼 부드러운 pad
soft_pad.task_measure: pull-out limit load (N); reference O carries the same pad
soft_pad.description: Drake, hydroelastic pads 0.1 MPa over each pad's own thickness, against O carrying the same pad; experiment 25

acquire.label: grasp 획득
acquire.task_measure: distance the cylinder is drawn in toward the MCP (mm)
acquire.description: Drake point; closing from open to draw a cylinder in against a load; experiment 23

dial.label: 다이얼
dial.description: Drake point; turning a sprung dial by 15-42 deg in one closing; experiment 26

contact_setpoint.label: 접촉 기준 setpoint
contact_setpoint.task_measure: pull-out limit load (N), joint setpoint re-chosen per hand from the kinematics
contact_setpoint.description: Drake point; each hand's joint setpoint re-chosen from the kinematics so its distal fingertip contact point matches O's (no runtime contact); experiment 27; pull-out

rolling.label: in-hand rolling
rolling.task_measure: cylinder rotation during the flexion sweep (deg)
rolling.description: Drake point; rolling a cylinder in hand by a flexion sweep; experiment 22
